summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (113/27)

data.turoyo: W ḥzayu u zlam, d howe malko, w bəṯr d nofəl faqir, be aydarbo mitarzəl, mən zaḥme yo!
data.translation: - Seht, wie ein Mann, der König ist, und nachher Arm und elend wird, welche Mühe er sich machen muß! -

rationale: First Detransitive Infectum box under rzl III, with the whole short evaluative sentence retained.

summary: Both occurrences checked. mitarzəl supplies the Infectum counterpart to the inherited Detransitive Preterit marzəl; this is a nonagentive misery/disgrace function, not an inferred active action.
Consulted full ryzl: it has I mrayzele/mrayzəl and Detransitive forms with y. Semantic and etymological proximity does not license merging its morphology with rzl III.
Retain inherited base forms and the source marzəl/mitarzəl variation rather than silently inserting t into the old example.
Are rzl III and ryzl I contact variants of one lexeme, or should their paradigms remain separate?
Confirm the marzəl versus mtarzəl variation between the inherited quotation and heading.
Make wurden agree with the plural Kleider
rationale: Kleider is plural, requiring wurden rather than wurde in this passive construction. The corpus also has plural hawən aǧ ǧulayḏe qṭiʕi.

summary: Correct the plural of Laus: Läusse → Läuse
rationale: The plural of Laus is Läuse, as in the supplied edition translation.
